turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
getting in touch! Yes, we ship to many international destinations 🌍 Available shipping options are shown at checkout. If no options appear, we’re unable to ship to that location at the moment.

Any customs, duties, or handling charges are set by the destination country’s authorities and are paid by the customer in addition to the product price. These charges vary by country, so we recommend checking your local import rules before ordering.

You can find the full Shipping & Handling Policy here.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
Priority Shipping usually takes 2 to 7 business days from the shipment date for domestic orders. Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days, so the shipping timeframe does not begin when the order is placed.

For international orders, delivery usually takes 15 to 20 business days from the shipment date. Business days exclude Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays, and weather, holidays, or customs clearance can add time.

You can find more details in our Shipping & Handling Policy 💖

turns.q: How do I contact your support team if I have an issue with an order?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out about an order issue. Please email support@evryjewels.com and include:

Your order number
Photos of the items received, if relevant
A clear description of the issue
Any other details that may help us assist you

EVRYJEWELS support is available by email rather than phone.
